actions.description: Lists every AI agent, grouped by floor (manager, worker, rest). Seeds the confirmed roster once when empty.
actions.name: listagents

actions.description: Recruits a new AI agent with brand, model, access type, floor, status, and quota setup (subscription cycle or API balance).
actions.name: createagent

actions.description: Edits one agent's brand, model, access type, specialty, or status.
actions.name: updateagent

actions.description: Moves one agent to another floor (manager, worker, or rest).
actions.name: moveagent

actions.description: Removes one agent entirely.
actions.name: deleteagent

actions.description: Sets one agent's quota bar: kind (subscription/API/none), percent remaining (null = not filled in), note such as refresh cycle.
actions.name: setagentquota

actions.description: Lists all-hands group chat messages, oldest first.
actions.name: listgroupmessages

actions.description: Posts a plain message into the group chat, as Gao or as an agent (usually the manager).
actions.name: postgroupmessage

actions.description: Lists every dispatch task with status, newest first.
actions.name: listtasks

actions.description: Publishes a task into the group chat: for one named worker, or open for any worker to claim.
actions.name: createtask

actions.description: A worker claims a task in the group chat; task moves to accepted/working, claim note lands in group, private thread opens.
actions.name: claimtask

actions.description: Lists chat messages of one dispatch task, oldest first, including delivery and system messages.
actions.name: listmessages

actions.description: Posts a chat or delivery message to a task thread as a given agent; a delivery also marks the task delivered.
actions.name: postmessage

actions.description: Moves a task along assigned, accepted, working, delivered, accepted_done, rejected, and logs a system message.
actions.name: updatetaskstatus

actions.description: Hands a task to another worker (GrokBot-style delegation); private thread and group get a transfer note.
actions.name: reassigntask

actions.description: Deletes a dispatch task and all of its chat messages.
actions.name: deletetask

actions.description: Manager consolidates a delivered task and posts the final result into the group chat for Gao.
actions.name: deliverfinalresult

actions.description: Gao reviews the final result: verified = accepted and complete, rejected = back for rework.
actions.name: reviewfinalresult

actions.description: Lists the whole skill library plus which agent carries which skill. Seeds the starter library once when empty.
actions.name: listskills

actions.description: Adds a new reusable skill to the skill library.
actions.name: createskill

actions.description: Edits one skill's name, category, description, fixed steps, match keywords, or savings note.
actions.name: updateskill

actions.description: Removes one skill and unequips it from every agent carrying it.
actions.name: deleteskill

actions.description: Equips a skill on an agent or takes it off; equipping is idempotent.
actions.name: setagentskill

actions.description: A senior manager model analyzes every member's specialty against every skill and returns scored recommendations with reasons.
actions.name: analyzeskillassignments

actions.description: Applies a batch of skill assignment changes judged by a senior model, and posts a summary notice into the group chat.
actions.name: applyskillassignments
